title: Plan seat cuts before every renewal
summary: Pro now shows a renewal savings plan for each upcoming Microsoft subscription and contract: paid, unassigned, reclaimable and active seats, the seat count to renew at with an adjustable buffer, the seats to cut and the yearly savings. Download any renewal as a calendar file, filter findings to one subscription, and export a PowerShell script for it. Trial seats never count as savings, unpriced seats show as seats only, and hidden usage data is marked as a conservative estimate. Free workspaces see their own total from live data.
